about_the_game:
Pixel Survivors: Defense is a high-octane fusion of strategic Tower Defense and Roguelite survival. Stand your ground against relentless swarms of monsters—it’s not just about surviving; it’s about becoming an unstoppable force of pixelated destruction!

Addictive Gameplay – Master the Chaos

Forget complex controls! Focus on positioning and strategy while your heroes auto-attack through the madness. Every run is a unique challenge thanks to randomized skill trees, powerful item synergies, and evolving enemy patterns.

Infinite Evolution & Meta-Progression

Slay enemies, harvest XP, and transcend! Each level-up is a strategic choice to craft game-breaking combos, turning basic attacks into screen-clearing nightmares for your foes.

Massive Arsenal & Legendary Heroes

  • 10+ Unique Heroes: Command a roster of elites, each with distinct attack styles and game-changing passive abilities.

  • 50+ Distinctive Items: Mix and match gears to build the ultimate "broken" setup every single run.

  • 10+ Devastating Skills: From meteor showers to lightning storms—choose your path to dominate the battlefield.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 processor or later that's SSE2 capable
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium D
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM

short_description: Unleash bullet hell in this strategic fusion of Tower Defense and Roguelite! Command elite heroes, craft powerful item combos, and survive relentless monster swarms. How long can you stand against the pixelated chaos? Every death is just a new beginning.
supported_languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese
